verdict.rationale: Simular's Sai documents running on cloud Windows computers and on bring-your-own macOS (including Mac mini) and Windows devices, so the same agent does target more than one OS. However, per-target support is only a one-line list with no per-OS capability or limitation documentation, and there is no Linux or mobile evidence. Missing for 10: detailed per-OS support documentation, Linux/mobile targets, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-OS behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, the same agent targets more than one OS (macOS, Windows, Linux, or mobile) with documented per-target support

citations.quote: Sai's BYOD supports devices including Mac mini, macOS and Windows.
Sai completes it on a cloud Windows computer.
